scope: completed expanded forty spent development seeds only; no formal or expert-strength claim

opening.common: teacher-v1 exchange and missing for all seats
opening.composite: each policy; both ebony references share teacher-v1 exchange only

manifest.pairing: same initial seed, then trajectories and draw recipients may diverge; seed-cluster statistics

summary.uncertainty: 同种子内指定座位、阵容和开局等权平均，再按种子估计标准误及95%正态近似区间。共享初始牌墙不保证动作分歧后各家摸牌相同，也不保证降噪；小样本只作诊断，各开局分层单独解释，不自动判定通过。

limitations: Seeds 60000..60039 were already spent in earlier development and are not holdout.
Official inference uses forty seed means and mean plus or minus 1.96 sample SE; no bootstrap.
All comparisons and strata are exploratory; no multiple comparison correction or automatic pass.
Initial and advanced references share one source; no expert level established.
Common versus composite changes opponent openings in external lineups; teacher lineup isolates own missing-suit choice.
No candidate production page integration; default teacher unchanged.
Eight-seed diagnostic results are reported separately, not pooled selectively.
